profile.summary: I am an engineer with a passion for embedded systems, cyber-physical devices, and software development. I am always eager to learn new things and solve problems. I have proven experience in assessing problems and recommending sustainable solutions. I am also experienced in working directly with internal and external customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Architected and delivered software platforms that streamlined complex engineering and failure-analysis workflows by consolidating fragmented tools, data sources, and diagnostic capabilities into customizable desktop environments. 
· Led the design and implementation of AI-assisted engineering solutions, selecting technologies and architectural patterns for autonomous reasoning, enterprise data access, and secure integration with internal systems. 
· Designed scalable orchestration frameworks for integrating dozens of tools and services, incorporating priority-based routing, fallback mechanisms, connection recovery, and structured error handling to maintain reliable operation during partial service disruptions. 
· Developed multi-stage research and analysis pipelines using state-based workflows, parallel data retrieval, relevance filtering, early termination, and progressive escalation to balance response time, accuracy, and analytical depth. 
· Built software and automation for validation systems used across internal and customer manufacturing environments, including specialized build variants, automated asset management, and telemetry verification. 
· Designed diagnostic data models and topology-mapping infrastructure supporting more than 10 storage product families, enabling die-level correlation between manufacturing data, physical device characteristics, and observed failures. 
· Improved software quality and maintainability through code reviews, defect investigation, debugging, testing, and implementation of corrective changes across multiple codebases. 
· Mentored junior developers through technical guidance, design feedback, troubleshooting support, and professional development. 
· Communicated engineering concepts, architectural decisions, risks, and project outcomes effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

positions.title: Product Failure Analysis Engineer
positions.description:
•	Conducted comprehensive failure analysis of SSD customer returned products, including hardware and firmware, at the component and system levels. Determined root causes and implemented closed-loop corrective actions.
•	Heavily involved with electrical analysis of NVMe and SATA SSDs
•	Designed and developed Pic microcontroller-based voltage measuring board for SSDs
•	Delivered problem resolutions through a strategic data-driven approach to systems updates and dashboards (PowerBI) and metrics
•	Developed Software Tools using for Validation systems specially for validating memory products at Customer Factories
•	Programmed internal automation software using Python and BASH that speeds up team workflow
•	Communicated effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.

positions.title: SSD Technical
positions.description:
•	Used SQL and Power BI to create automated dashboards that improved data visibility to VPs and executives. This resulted in increased efficiency and decision-making accuracy.
•	Successfully debugged hardware issues by using LeCroy protocol analyzers to capture traces and working with Firmware Engineering to root cause ASIC issues. This led to a significant reduction in downtime and improved product quality.
•	Programmed performance testing for continuous automated data collection using Python and BASH. This ensured that data was collected and analyzed in a timely manner, which helped to identify and resolve performance issues early on.
•	Created documentation that is used as the best-known method for recovering customer qual return drives. This has saved the company time and money by reducing the need for manual intervention.
•	Upgraded/Downgraded/Recovered SATA and PCIe SSDs to accelerate customer qualification. This has helped to ensure that customers receive their products on time and in working condition.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Inspired by the Maker Movement, the main goal of the Makecourse is to encourage and empower students early on in their careers to pursue their own design projects. All participating students will invent, design and build (i.e. make) a device following the engineering design process. The devices must integrate a 3D printed mechanical motion component as well as an electronic circuit/control feature designed with the Arduino micro-controller development platform. The students will also write a detailed "Instructable" (description of how to build their project) that will be published at Instructables.com. The instructional part of the course aims to teach essential skills in computer aided design (CAD) as well as entry level programming and electronic circuit design and implementation skills.

projects.title: CPU Cache Replacement Policy
projects.description: Implemented a new cache replacement policy in a CPU simulator using C++. Benchmarked the new policy against LRU and random cache replacement policies.

projects.title: Non-invasive health monitoring wearable
projects.description: A portable device that measures pulse, oxygenation, temperature, and blood glucose levels through non-invasive means. The system is a part of an ecosystem that monitors and records the progress of the wearer. Programmed the microcontroller and designed the PCB for this project.
